purpose: Independent-source clinical challenge of the same frozen K. pneumoniae meropenem predictor and its fixed rule; not a representative clinical deployment study

candidate_studies.assay: BMD, EUCAST v13 per primary paper
candidate_studies.limitations: Selected carbapenem-resistant collection; the paper identifies two meropenem-susceptible carbapenemase-positive isolates, which does not establish the total S count. Confirm full S/I/R denominators from the primary matrix before performance claims.
Selected for MIC/MLVA/carbapenemase diversity; 74 phenotyped isolates do not provide 74 linked genomes

feature_pipeline: Preserved FILE11C caller; AMRFinderPlus 4.2.7, DB 2026-08-07.1, nucleotide mode, Klebsiella_pneumoniae, same element naming/schema and emrD exclusion as original code
gates: Verify model and schema hashes before reading/executing a supplied model artifact.
Reproduce preserved E2 probabilities from original external feature matrix before scoring any new genome; maximum absolute probability difference <=1e-8.
Obtain an original isolate-level MIC table and verify sample-to-genome/assay/drug/unit links; a genotype is never used as phenotypic truth.
Retain all raw MIC inequalities, original S/I/R and standards/context; ambiguous interval/category mappings remain ambiguous.
Confirm genome species with a documented taxonomic check; discordant source annotations are reported, not silently forced into K. pneumoniae.
Primary binary analysis includes explicit source S and R; retain and report I/ND separately, without forcing them into S or R.
If only quantitative MICs are available, require stated standard/edition and clinical interpretation context before deriving a labeled reference scenario; do not call it the author-reported category.
Check exact sample, assembly/genome and original grouping/firewall overlap with development and E2; unknown overlap prevents an independence claim.
Keep all model weights, probabilities, rule definition and threshold fixed; no threshold or feature tuning using challenge labels.
Report false-susceptible/false-resistant counts and denominators first, then discrimination metrics where both classes have enough support; describe patient/lineage dependence.
Treat the cohorts as selected challenge sets; do not infer population clinical utility, safety, or calibration from them.

existing_CDC_challenge_route.claim_limits: Existing pilot labels were inspected; enriched panels and possible training overlap prevent presuming a new independent clinical validation.
